slice.title: Service requests board
slice.goal: Build the initial service requests board prototype: list requests, create request records, edit status/priority, search by title or requester, and filter by status and priority using local JSON mock storage.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a list of requests with title, requester, status, priority, and due date.
User can create a request with title, requester, status, priority, and due date.
User can edit an existing request's status and priority.
User can search requests by title or requester.
User can filter requests by status.
User can filter requests by priority.
The main screen and interactive controls have stable data-prototype-id anchors linked to scheme elements.
The prototype uses local JSON mock storage and does not require external integrations.
constraints: No workflow automation or notifications in this slice.
No attachments or comments in this slice.
Use local JSON mock storage from the sample mock plan.
No new dependencies beyond the selected kit.
Do not implement delete request in this slice.

notes: This scenario intentionally differs from customers-app and products-app: it has two enum filters, a due_date field, and editable workflow-like status/priority fields.
Use it to check whether CRUD/list/search/filter contracts generalize beyond contact and catalog examples.
